OUE BAYFRONT
ONE RAFFLES PLACE
OUE DOWNTOWN OFFICE
Property Description
Located at Collyer Quay in 
Singapore’s central business 
district (“CBD”), OUE Bayfront 
is a premium Grade A office 
building which occupies a 
vantage position between the 
Marina Bay downtown and 
established financial hub of 
Raffles Place.
One of the tallest buildings  
in the Singapore CBD, One 
Raffles Place is an iconic 
commercial development 
comprising two Grade A office 
towers and a retail mall, 
strategically located in  
the heart of main financial
district Raffles Place.
OUE Downtown Office is part  
of the OUE Downtown mixed-
use development, a refurbished 
landmark property comprising 
Grade A offices, a retail  
podium as well as serviced 
residences, strategically 
located in Shenton Way.
